Deep Sedation in Single-Shot Pulmonary Vein Isolation: A Head-to-Head Look at Two Pulsed Field Versus Cryoballoon Ablation Approaches.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Deep sedation (DS) is routinely used during single-shot pulmonary vein isolation (PVI) to optimize patient comfort and procedural stability. However, data on sedative requirements and procedural tolerance of pulsed field ablation (PFA) under DS compared with thermal technologies remain limited.

METHODS: In this single-center study, consecutive patients underwent PVI with cryoballoon (CB), PFA using a pentaspline catheter (PC) or the balloon-in-basket catheter (BC). All procedures were performed under DS with midazolam, fentanyl, and propofol, administered by electrophysiology staff without anaesthesiologist supervision. Propensity score matching (1:1:1) was applied for age, sex, body mass index, and hypertension. Procedural characteristics, sedative/analgesic requirements, and complications were analyzed.

RESULTS: Acute PVI without major complications was achieved in all 156 enrolled patients. PC procedures were associated with higher body-weight- and time-adjusted requirements for propofol (CB: 0.10 ± 0.04 mg/kg/min; PC: 0.15 ± 0.04 mg/kg/min; BC: 0.11 ± 0.03 mg/kg/min; p < 0.001) despite the lowest total dose of propofol used (CB: 440 ± 144 mg; PC: 348± 80 mg; BC: 433 ± 160 mg; p = 0.00). Procedural times (CB: 47.5 [40-60] min, PC: 29 [25-35] min, BC: 47.5 [40-56] min, p < 0.001) and fluoroscopy times (CB: 9.5 [6.3-13.6] min; PC: 6.2 [4.4-9] min; BC: 7.2 [6.1-11.2] min, p = 0.001) were shortest in the PC group. Sedation-related hemodynamic stability was comparable across all cohorts.

CONCLUSIONS: The novel BC demonstrated excellent feasibility under DS, with reduced normalized sedative requirements compared with the PC and a safety profile comparable to CB ablation. These findings suggest that optimized waveform design and field homogeneity may enable safe and comfortable PVI under DS without the need for general anesthesia.

AI.tldr: 在深度镇静下，五分支脉冲场消融导管虽手术时间最短，但体重和时间校正的丙泊酚需求最高；球囊篮式导管可行性好且镇静需求低于五分支导管，安全性媲美冷冻球囊。
AI.motivation: 深度镇静常用于单次肺静脉隔离以优化患者舒适度和手术稳定性，但脉冲场消融与热消融技术在深度镇静下的镇静需求和手术耐受性数据有限，尤其缺乏不同脉冲场消融导管之间的头对头比较。
AI.method: 单中心研究，连续纳入156例接受肺静脉隔离的患者，分为冷冻球囊组、五分支脉冲场消融导管组和球囊篮式导管组。所有手术在深度镇静下进行，由电生理人员使用咪达唑仑、芬太尼和丙泊酚给药，无麻醉医师监督。采用倾向性评分匹配（1:1:1）匹配年龄、性别、体重指数和高血压。分析手术特征、镇静/镇痛需求和并发症。
AI.result: 所有156例患者均实现急性肺静脉隔离且无重大并发症。五分支导管组体重和时间校正的丙泊酚需求最高（冷冻球囊：0.10 ± 0.04 mg/kg/min；五分支：0.15 ± 0.04 mg/kg/min；球囊篮式：0.11 ± 0.03 mg/kg/min；p < 0.001），尽管其丙泊酚总剂量最低（冷冻球囊：440 ± 144 mg；五分支：348 ± 80 mg；球囊篮式：433 ± 160 mg；p = 0.00）。五分支组手术时间（冷冻球囊：47.5 [40-60] min，五分支：29 [25-35] min，球囊篮式：47.5 [40-56] min，p < 0.001）和透视时间（冷冻球囊：9.5 [6.3-13.6] min；五分支：6.2 [4.4-9] min；球囊篮式：7.2 [6.1-11.2] min，p = 0.001）最短。镇静相关血流动力学稳定性在各组间相当。
AI.conclusion: 新型球囊篮式导管在深度镇静下可行性良好，与五分支导管相比降低了标准化镇静需求，安全性媲美冷冻球囊消融。这些发现提示优化的波形设计和电场均匀性可能使深度镇静下安全舒适的肺静脉隔离成为可能，无需全身麻醉。

Social Support and Quality of Life in Patients with Persistent Atrial Fibrillation: The Mediating Role of Illness Perception.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Persistent atrial fibrillation is associated with impaired quality of life and adverse health outcomes. Psychosocial factors, particularly social support and illness perception, may influence patients' adaptation to the disease. However, the mediating role of illness perception in the relationship between social support and quality of life has not been adequately investigated.

OBJECTIVE: To examine the association between perceived social support and quality of life and whether this association operates indirectly through illness perception in patients with persistent atrial fibrillation.

METHODS: In this cross-sectional study, 150 patients with persistent atrial fibrillation were recruited from hospitals affiliated with Tehran University of Medical Sciences in 2025. Data were collected using the Multidimensional Scale of Perceived Social Support, Brief Illness Perception Questionnaire, and Atrial Fibrillation Effect on Quality of Life questionnaire. Mediation analysis was performed using PROCESS Macro Model 4.

RESULTS: Social support was positively associated with illness perception and quality of life (P<0.001), with higher illness perception scores indicating a more threatening perception of illness. Illness perception was also positively associated with quality of life (P<0.001) and partially accounted for the association between social support and quality of life (indirect effect = 0.091, 95% CI: 0.036-0.144). The model explained 57.5% of the variance in quality of life.

CONCLUSIONS: Social support and illness perception were significantly associated with quality of life in patients with persistent atrial fibrillation. These findings highlight the importance of considering patients' perceived illness and social support when providing patient-centered care to support quality of life.

AI.motivation: 持续性房颤患者生活质量受损，社会支持和疾病感知等心理社会因素可能影响疾病适应，但疾病感知在社会支持与生活质量之间的中介作用尚未充分研究。
AI.method: 横断面研究，纳入2025年德黑兰医科大学附属医院的150例持续性房颤患者。使用多维感知社会支持量表、简易疾病感知问卷和房颤生活质量问卷收集数据。采用PROCESS宏模型4进行中介分析。
AI.result: 社会支持与疾病感知和生活质量均呈正相关（P<0.001），疾病感知评分越高表示对疾病的威胁感知越强。疾病感知与生活质量也呈正相关（P<0.001），并部分中介社会支持与生活质量之间的关联（间接效应=0.091，95%CI：0.036-0.144）。模型解释生活质量57.5%的变异。
AI.conclusion: 社会支持和疾病感知与持续性房颤患者的生活质量显著相关。提供以患者为中心的护理时，应考虑患者的疾病感知和社会支持，以支持生活质量。本研究为横断面设计，无法推断因果关系，且样本来源单一，结论外推需谨慎。

目的：探讨持续性心房颤动患者感知社会支持与生活质量之间的关联，以及这种关联是否通过疾病感知间接发挥作用。

方法：在这项横断面研究中，于2025年从德黑兰医科大学附属医院招募了150例持续性心房颤动患者。使用多维感知社会支持量表、简易疾病感知问卷和心房颤动对生活质量影响问卷收集数据。使用PROCESS宏程序模型4进行中介分析。

结论：社会支持和疾病感知与持续性心房颤动患者的生活质量显著相关。这些发现强调了在提供以患者为中心的护理以支持生活质量时，考虑患者感知的疾病和社会支持的重要性。

title: Left atrial functional characteristics using speckle tracking echocardiography in patients with non-valvular atrial fibrillation
summary: Objective: To investigate the functional characteristics of the left atrium using speckle tracking echocardiography in patients with non-valvular atrial fibrillation. Methods: A cross-sectional descriptive study was conducted on 46 patients with non-valvular atrial fibrillation and 33 control subjects without cardiovascular disease. All participants underwent evaluation for clinical symptoms, medical history, physical examination, electrocardiography, and echocardiography, including speckle tracking echocardiography to assess left atrial function. Results: From June 2023 to September 2025, 46 patients with non-valvular atrial fibrillation were enrolled in the study, alongside 33 control subjects with comparable age, BMI, and heart rate. The results demonstrated that patients with non-valvular atrial fibrillation had significantly reduced left atrial diameter on 2D, left atrial volume index (LAVi), reservoir function (LASr), conduit function (LAScd), and contraction function (LASct) compared to the control group (p < 0.001). No significant differences were observed in left atrial size and function among atrial fibrillation patients based on heart failure status. A trend toward lower LASr and LASct was observed in the atrial fibrillation patients who experienced stroke, howerver, the small number of stroke events limited the statistical power and precluded robust statistical comparisons. LAScd was decreased in atrial fibrillation patients aged 65 years. Conclusion: Left atrial reservoir, conduit, and contraction functions are all significantly reduced on speckle tracking echocardiography in patients with non-valvular atrial fibrillation.

title: Knowledge and adherence to oral anticoagulant therapy among patients with non-valvular atrial fibrillation at Hanoi Heart Hospital in 2025
summary: Objective: Non-valvular atrial fibrillation (NVAF) is a major risk factor for embolic stroke, necessitating lifelong oral anticoagulation (OAC) therapy. The effectiveness of OAC in clinical practice is heavily dependent on patient adherence and knowledge. This study aimed to describe the current status of knowledge and practice regarding OAC therapy and to identify factors associated with treatment adherence among NVAF outpatients at the Voluntary Outpatient Department of Hanoi Heart Hospital). Methods: A descriptive cross-sectional study was conducted on 100 NVAF outpatients from May 2025 to December 2025. Data were collected through face-to-face interviews using a structured questionnaire. Knowledge was assessed using the Oral Anticoagulation Knowledge Tool (AKT) by Obamiro, where a score of ≥60% was considered "adequate". Treatment adherence was measured using the 8-item Morisky Medication Adherence Scale (MMAS-8), classified into high (8 points), medium (6-7 points), and low (<6 points) adherence levels. Statistical analysis was performed using SPSS 20.0, utilizing Fisher’s Exact Test and univariate logistic regression to calculate Odds Ratios (OR) with a 95% confidence interval (CI). Results: The mean age of the participants was 63.4 ± 10.1 years, with 57% being male. Most patients had co-morbidities, including hypertension (51%), heart failure (46%), and coronary artery disease (41%). Regarding knowledge, 78% of participants were classified as having "inadequate knowledge". Specifically, 84% could not correctly identify the name of their anticoagulant, 98% believed they could stop the medication when feeling well, and 72% were unaware that missing a dose could worsen their condition. In terms of adherence, only 25% achieved high adherence, while 53% showed medium adherence and 22% showed low adherence. Common barriers included forgetting medication while traveling (49%) and general difficulty in remembering the daily regimen (39%). Associated factors for adequate knowledge included having a reminder for medication (OR=5.64, 95%CI: 1.71-18.56, p<0.01). Factors significantly associated with better adherence included clear counseling from healthcare providers (OR=4.33, 95%CI: 1.60-11.69, p<0.01), having a medication reminder (OR=3.07, 95%CI: 1.05-8.95, p=0.04), and possessing adequate treatment knowledge (OR=3.50, 95%CI: 1.27-9.62, p=0.02). Conclusion: Knowledge and adherence regarding oral anticoagulation therapy among NVAF patients at Hanoi Heart Hospital are considerably limited. The study highlights that clinical outcomes can be significantly improved through effective medical counseling, family support systems (reminders), and targeted health education. These findings underscore the necessity for personalized patient management strategies and continuous educational interventions to optimize stroke prevention in AF populations.

AI.tldr: 越南河内心脏医院100例非瓣膜性房颤门诊患者中，78%对抗凝治疗知识不足，仅25%达到高依从性，清晰的医疗咨询和用药提醒与更好的依从性相关。
AI.motivation: 非瓣膜性房颤是栓塞性卒中的重要危险因素，需终身口服抗凝治疗，但临床实践中抗凝效果高度依赖患者依从性和知识水平。既往证据在越南人群中关于抗凝知识与依从性现状及其相关因素的数据有限，本研究旨在填补这一缺口。
AI.method: 2025年5月至12月在河内心脏医院自愿门诊部开展描述性横断面研究，纳入100例非瓣膜性房颤门诊患者。通过面对面结构化问卷收集数据，采用Obamiro口服抗凝知识工具（AKT）评估知识，≥60%定义为知识充足；采用8项Morisky服药依从性量表（MMAS-8）评估依从性，分为高（8分）、中（6-7分）、低（<6分）三级。使用SPSS 20.0进行Fisher精确检验和单因素logistic回归，计算比值比（OR）及95%置信区间（CI）。
AI.result: 患者平均年龄63.4±10.1岁，57%为男性；合并症包括高血压（51%）、心力衰竭（46%）和冠心病（41%）。78%的患者知识不足：84%不能正确识别抗凝药名称，98%认为感觉良好时可停药，72%不知道漏服会加重病情。依从性方面，仅25%为高依从性，53%为中依从性，22%为低依从性；常见障碍包括旅行时忘记服药（49%）和日常记不住服药方案（39%）。知识充足的相关因素为有用药提醒（OR=5.64，95%CI：1.71-18.56，p<0.01）。与更好依从性显著相关的因素包括：医护人员清晰咨询（OR=4.33，95%CI：1.60-11.69，p<0.01）、有用药提醒（OR=3.07，95%CI：1.05-8.95，p=0.04）和具备充足治疗知识（OR=3.50，95%CI：1.27-9.62，p=0.02）。

title: Zero-fluoroscopy radiofrequency catheter ablation: results from Hanoi Heart Hospital
summary: Objective: To evaluate the clinical and procedural characteristic, efficacy and safety of catheter ablation of cardiac arrhythmias using a three-dimensional (3D) electro-anatomical mapping system without fluoroscopy at Hanoi Heart Hospital. Methods: This cross-sectional study with follow-up included 97 patients who underwent electrophysiological study and catheter ablation using a 3D electroanatomical mapping system without fluoroscopy at Hanoi Heart Hospital from January to December 2025. The treated arrhythmias included premature ventricular contractions (PVCs), atrioventricular nodal reentrant tachycardia (AVNRT), Wolff–Parkinson–White (WPW) syndrome, atrioventricular reentrant tachycardia (AVRT), atrial tachycardia (AT), and ventricular tachycardia (VT). Clinical characteristics, procedural duration, ablation time, procedural success, complications, and arrhythmia recurrence during follow-up were recorded. Results: The mean age was 47.0 ± 17.5 years, and 66.0% of patients were female. PVCs were the most common arrhythmia (53.6%), followed by AVNRT (22.7%) and WPW syndrome (12.5%). The mean procedure duration was 47.2 ± 12.1 minutes, while the mean ablation time was 266.0 ± 155.8 seconds. Overall procedural success was achieved in 96 of 97 patients (98.9%). No cases of cardiac tamponade, pneumothorax, coronary spasm, persistent complete atrioventricular block, or vascular complications at the access site were recorded. One patient developed transient atrioventricular block, which recovered spontaneously, and two patients experienced transient right bundle branch block. Five patients had model displacement (5,15%), necessitating re-mapping. During a median follow-up of 10 (7–13) months, two cases of arrhythmia recurrence were documented. Conclusion: Catheter ablation of cardiac arrhythmias using a 3D electroanatomical mapping system without fluoroscopy was feasible in selected patients, with a high procedural success rate and a low rate of complications. Pre-procedure preparation is crucial to avoid model displacement.

title: An ICAM1⁺ inflammatory fibroblast state in atrial fibrillation and metabolic-stress-associated atrial remodeling.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Atrial fibrillation (AF) is associated with inflammatory and fibrotic atrial remodeling, but the fibroblast states connecting these processes remain incompletely defined. ICAM1 is a key inflammatory adhesion molecule, yet its cell-state context within atrial fibroblast heterogeneity remains unclear.

RESULTS: Reanalysis of human left atrial single-cell RNA sequencing data identified an ICAM1⁺ inflammatory fibroblast state that was not detected among fibroblasts from sinus rhythm samples in this dataset and represented 17.3% of fibroblasts in AF samples. Trajectory inference, pathway enrichment, and co-expression network analysis associated this state with inflammatory and matrix-remodeling programs. In diet-induced obesity (DIO) mice, susceptibility to burst pacing-induced AF-like atrial tachyarrhythmia episodes was higher than in normal-diet controls (5/8 vs. 0/8 mice; Fisher's exact P = 0.0256), accompanied by left atrial remodeling. RNA fluorescence in situ hybridization supported increased Icam1 expression in Tcf21⁺ fibroblast-associated stromal cells. ICAM1 protein was increased in CD140a-enriched atrial fibroblast fractions from DIO mice (relative ICAM1/β-actin: 2.70 ± 0.46 vs. 1.00 ± 0.15; P = 0.0001). In primary human cardiac fibroblasts, ICAM1 knockdown reduced migration under TGF-β1-stimulated conditions (49.90 ± 1.63% vs. 20.44 ± 1.51% wound closure; P < 0.0001), and reduced α-SMA and Collagen I fluorescence signals. Lentiviral TNXB overexpression partially restored Fibronectin and Collagen I expression under ICAM1-knockdown conditions (Fibronectin: 2.26 ± 0.21-fold vs. 4.11 ± 0.28-fold, P < 0.0001; Collagen I: 1.09 ± 0.06-fold vs. 1.54 ± 0.09-fold, P = 0.0004).

CONCLUSIONS: This study identifies an AF-enriched ICAM1⁺ inflammatory fibroblast state associated with inflammatory-matrix remodeling programs. The findings support Icam1 upregulation in fibroblast-associated atrial stromal cells during DIO-associated remodeling and link ICAM1 perturbation to altered fibroblast migration and selected TNXB-associated matrix-protein readouts. Further fibroblast-specific and clinically annotated studies are needed to define causality and translational relevance.

title: Carbon monoxide exposure and the risk of cardiac arrhythmia: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
summary: Although carbon monoxide (CO) exposure is associated with cardiovascular diseases, its relationship with cardiac arrhythmias remains unclear. This meta-analysis evaluated the association between CO exposure and arrhythmia risk in the general population and patients with implantable cardioverter-defibrillators (ICDs). PubMed, Cochrane Library, Web of Science, and Embase were searched from inception to June 2025. English-language studies investigating CO exposure and arrhythmias or ventricular arrhythmias were included. Adjusted estimates were pooled as odds ratios (ORs) or hazard ratios (HRs) with 95% confidence intervals (CIs) using random-effects models. Heterogeneity was assessed using the I2 statistic, and study quality was evaluated using the Newcastle-Ottawa Scale. Seventeen studies were included: seven involving the general population and ten involving ICD patients. In the general population, CO exposure was significantly associated with increased arrhythmia risk (OR: 1.07; 95% CI: 1.02-1.13; p = 0.01; HR: 1.25; 95% CI: 1.01-1.53; p = 0.04). However, no significant association was observed in ICD patients for arrhythmias (OR: 1.02; 95% CI: 0.99-1.02; p = 0.20) or ventricular arrhythmias (OR: 1.03; 95% CI: 0.99-1.06; p = 0.18). These findings suggest that CO exposure increases arrhythmia risk in the general population, whereas no significant association was identified in ICD patients.

AI.tldr: 系统评价与荟萃分析显示，一氧化碳暴露与一般人群心律失常风险升高相关（OR 1.07、HR 1.25），但在植入式心律转复除颤器（ICD）患者中未见显著关联。

AI.result: 一般人群中，一氧化碳暴露与心律失常风险升高显著相关（OR 1.07，95%CI 1.02-1.13，P=0.01；HR 1.25，95%CI 1.01-1.53，P=0.04）。ICD患者中，一氧化碳暴露与心律失常（OR 1.02，95%CI 0.99-1.02，P=0.20）及室性心律失常（OR 1.03，95%CI 0.99-1.06，P=0.18）均无显著关联。异质性及研究质量的具体数值摘要未报告。
AI.conclusion: 一氧化碳暴露可能升高一般人群的心律失常风险，但在ICD患者中未观察到显著关联，提示该效应可能存在人群异质性。临床电生理实践中，对一般人群进行一氧化碳暴露评估或有助于心律失常风险分层；但ICD人群证据有限，且纳入研究以观察性研究为主，混杂与暴露测量偏倚难以排除，结论需谨慎解读。

summary_zh: 尽管一氧化碳（CO）暴露与心血管疾病相关，但其与心律失常的关系仍不明确。本荟萃分析评估了CO暴露与一般人群及植入式心律转复除颤器（ICD）患者心律失常风险之间的关联。检索了PubMed、Cochrane Library、Web of Science和Embase从建库至2025年6月的文献。纳入研究CO暴露与心律失常或室性心律失常的英文文献。采用随机效应模型，将校正后的估计值合并为比值比（OR）或风险比（HR）及其95%置信区间（CI）。使用I2统计量评估异质性，并使用纽卡斯尔-渥太华量表评估研究质量。共纳入17项研究：7项涉及一般人群，10项涉及ICD患者。在一般人群中，CO暴露与心律失常风险增加显著相关（OR：1.07；95% CI：1.02-1.13；p = 0.01；HR：1.25；95% CI：1.01-1.53；p = 0.04）。然而，在ICD患者中，未观察到CO暴露与心律失常（OR：1.02；95% CI：0.99-1.02；p = 0.20）或室性心律失常（OR：1.03；95% CI：0.99-1.06；p = 0.18）之间存在显著关联。这些发现表明，CO暴露增加一般人群的心律失常风险，而在ICD患者中未发现显著关联。

title: Associations of the Low Arousal Threshold With Arrhythmia Burden and Heart Rate Variability in Obstructive Sleep Apnea Using Polysomnography With 24-h Holter Electrocardiography.
summary: Obstructive sleep apnea (OSA) is a widespread condition that increases the risk of arrhythmias. Recently, the role of specific OSA phenotypes, including the low respiratory arousal threshold (ArTH) phenotype, has been largely explored. This study aimed to assess whether the estimated low ArTH in patients with obstructive sleep apnea is significantly associated with arrhythmia burden and alterations in heart rate variability (HRV). Data from adults who underwent full-night video-polysomnography (vPSG) with 24-h 12-lead Holter electrocardiography (ECG) were included. ArTH was estimated noninvasively using the Edwards method. Arrhythmias were scored and counted. HRV was quantified in time, geometric, and frequency domains using ECG across a predefined circadian schedule. The analysis included 166 participants; 134 were classified as low ArTH, and 32 as high ArTH. The low ArTH group had a lower supraventricular arrhythmia burden, including fewer supraventricular premature contractions (SVPC), fewer SVPC pairs, and fewer supraventricular tachycardia (SVT) episodes than the high ArTH group. Daytime HRV differed between the groups, with higher RMSSD in low ArTH and higher LF power. In multivariable analyses, low ArTH remained associated with SVPC and SVPC pairs. Differences in HRV parameters were limited and were largely attenuated after adjustment for clinical confounders. The results suggest the potential importance of the ArTH phenotype as an independent indicator of arrhythmia in patients with OSA. However, the results should be interpreted as exploratory and hypothesis gathering. Further, prospective studies are needed to assess the utility of ArTH in risk stratification.

AI.tldr: 在166例接受整夜视频多导睡眠监测和24小时动态心电图的OSA患者中，低觉醒阈值表型与较低的室上性心律失常负荷独立相关，但心率变异性差异有限。
AI.motivation: OSA增加心律失常风险，但特定OSA表型（如低呼吸觉醒阈值）与心律失常负荷及心率变异性的关系尚不明确，既往证据有限。
AI.method: 回顾性分析166例接受整夜视频多导睡眠监测和24小时12导联动态心电图的成人OSA患者，采用Edwards方法无创估算呼吸觉醒阈值，分为低觉醒阈值组（n=134）和高觉醒阈值组（n=32）。对心律失常进行评分和计数，并按预设昼夜时间表在时域、几何和频域量化心率变异性。采用多变量分析评估低觉醒阈值与心律失常及心率变异性的关联。
AI.result: 低觉醒阈值组室上性心律失常负荷较低：室上性早搏（SVPC）更少、SVPC成对更少、室上性心动过速（SVT）发作更少。日间心率变异性组间有差异，低觉醒阈值组RMSSD更高、LF功率更高。多变量分析中，低觉醒阈值仍与SVPC和SVPC成对独立相关。心率变异性参数差异有限，校正临床混杂因素后大部分减弱。
AI.conclusion: 低呼吸觉醒阈值表型可能是OSA患者心律失常的独立指标，但结果仅为探索性、假设生成性，需前瞻性研究评估其在风险分层中的效用。

summary_zh: 阻塞性睡眠呼吸暂停（OSA）是一种广泛存在的疾病，会增加心律失常的风险。近期，特定OSA表型的作用，包括低呼吸觉醒阈值（ArTH）表型，已被广泛探索。本研究旨在评估阻塞性睡眠呼吸暂停患者中估计的低ArTH是否与心律失常负荷及心率变异性（HRV）的改变显著相关。纳入接受整夜视频多导睡眠监测（vPSG）及24小时12导联动态心电图（ECG）的成人数据。ArTH采用Edwards方法无创估算。对心律失常进行评分和计数。HRV通过ECG在预定义的昼夜时间表上以时间域、几何域和频率域进行量化。分析纳入166名参与者；134名被归类为低ArTH，32名为高ArTH。低ArTH组的上室性心律失常负荷较低，包括较少的室上性期前收缩（SVPC）、较少的SVPC成对以及较少的室上性心动过速（SVT）发作，较高ArTH组少。日间HRV在两组间存在差异，低ArTH组RMSSD较高，LF功率较高。在多变量分析中，低ArTH仍与SVPC和SVPC成对相关。HRV参数的差异有限，且在调整临床混杂因素后大部分减弱。结果表明ArTH表型作为OSA患者心律失常的独立指标可能具有重要性。然而，结果应解释为探索性和假设生成性的。此外，需要进一步的前瞻性研究来评估ArTH在风险分层中的效用。

title: Eighteen Years of Complication-Free Survival Following Inadvertent Left Ventricular Implantable Cardioverter Defibrillator (ICD) Lead Placement via Atrial Septal Defect: A Case Report.
summary: Implantable cardioverter defibrillators (ICDs) are recommended for primary or secondary prevention in multiple cardiac conditions. One of the recognised complications during implantation of cardiac implantable electronic device (CIED) is inadvertent lead malposition in the left heart (ILMLH), which can lead to further thromboembolism and infective endocarditis. In this paper, we present a unique case of a patient who had an accidental ICD lead implanted into the left ventricle via an atrial septal defect (ASD). Evidence on the management of such a complication is rare. A watchful-wait approach with appropriate anticoagulation was adopted here, resulting in an uneventful 18-year survival. We also navigate through the current evidence on the recognition and management of such cases.

AI.tldr: 一例经房间隔缺损误入左心室的ICD导线患者，采用抗凝观察策略后18年无并发症生存。
AI.motivation: 心脏植入式电子器械（CIED）植入时导线误入左心（ILMLH）是已知并发症，可导致血栓栓塞和感染性心内膜炎，但关于其管理策略的证据罕见，缺乏统一指南。
AI.method: 病例报告。患者因适应症植入ICD，术中导线经房间隔缺损（ASD）意外进入左心室。采用观察等待策略并给予适当抗凝治疗，随访18年。同时综述现有关于ILMLH识别与管理的证据。
AI.result: 患者接受抗凝观察策略后，18年随访期间无血栓栓塞、感染性心内膜炎或其他并发症发生，生存无事件。摘要未报告具体抗凝方案及影像学随访细节。
AI.conclusion: 对于经ASD误入左室的ICD导线，在特定情况下抗凝观察策略可能安全可行，但需个体化评估。本案例为罕见并发症的管理提供了长期随访证据，但结论受限于单例报告，不能推广至所有ILMLH患者；临床实践中应优先考虑导线拔除或重新定位，并加强影像学确认。

summary_zh: 植入式心律转复除颤器（ICD）被推荐用于多种心脏疾病的一级或二级预防。心脏植入式电子设备（CIED）植入过程中公认的并发症之一是导线意外误入左心（ILMLH），这可能导致进一步的血栓栓塞和感染性心内膜炎。在本文中，我们报告一例独特的病例：患者因房间隔缺损（ASD），ICD导线被意外植入左心室。关于此类并发症处理的证据罕见。此处采用了密切观察等待策略并给予适当的抗凝治疗，结果患者18年生存无事件。我们还梳理了目前关于此类病例识别与处理的证据。

title: Mitral annular calcification on routine Non-ECG Gated Chest CT Is associated with advanced atrioventricular block requiring permanent pacing: A case-control study.
summary: The purpose of this study was to determine whether visual or quantitative mitral annular calcification (MAC) burden on routine non-contrast, non-ECG-gated chest computed tomography (CT) is associated with permanent pacemaker (PPM) implantation for advanced atrioventricular (AV) block. MAC has been linked to conduction disturbances after transcatheter aortic valve implantation (TAVI). Whether MAC visible on routine chest CT is associated with significant AV conduction disease in non-TAVI patients remains uncertain. In this retrospective single-center case-control study, 39 consecutive patients who underwent PPM implantation for symptomatic advanced AV block and had non-contrast chest CT were compared with 39 age- and sex-matched controls without AV block or prior PPM. MAC was graded visually by annular circumference involvement and quantified using an Agatston-based score. Visual MAC was more prevalent in the PPM (+) group than in the PPM (-) group (22 of 39 [56%] vs. 12 of 39 [31%]; P = 0.039). The prevalence of PPM implantation increased across visual MAC categories, from 39% with no MAC and 48% with MAC involving < 1/3 of the annular circumference to 80% with MAC involving 1/3 to 1/2 and 100% with MAC involving > 1/2 of the annular circumference (P = 0.007). Quantitative MAC categories also differed (44%, 33%, and 78% PPM implantation for MAC scores of 0, 1 to 400, and > 400, respectively; P = 0.022). In multivariable analysis, MAC score > 400 remained independently associated with PPM implantation (odds ratio: 24.6; 95% confidence interval: 1.63 to 370.96; P = 0.02).Visual and quantitative MAC burden on routine non-contrast chest CT were associated with PPM implantation for advanced AV block. Structured assessment and reporting of marked MAC may provide a clinically useful marker in patients with suspected AV conduction disease.

AI.tldr: 常规非门控胸部CT上二尖瓣环钙化（MAC）负荷与因晚期房室传导阻滞植入永久起搏器相关，MAC评分>400独立相关（OR 24.6）。
AI.motivation: MAC与TAVI术后传导障碍相关，但常规非对比、非心电门控胸部CT上MAC是否与非TAVI患者的显著房室传导疾病相关尚不明确。
AI.method: 回顾性单中心病例对照研究，39例因症状性晚期房室传导阻滞植入PPM且有非对比胸部CT的患者，与39例年龄性别匹配的无房室传导阻滞或既往PPM的对照比较。MAC通过瓣环周长受累程度视觉分级，并采用Agatston评分定量。终点为PPM植入。
AI.result: 视觉MAC在PPM(+)组更常见（56% vs 31%，P=0.039）。PPM植入率随视觉MAC分级增加：无MAC 39%，MAC<1/3周长48%，1/3-1/2周长80%，>1/2周长100%（P=0.007）。定量MAC分级亦不同：评分0、1-400、>400的PPM植入率分别为44%、33%、78%（P=0.022）。多变量分析中，MAC评分>400独立与PPM植入相关（OR 24.6；95%CI 1.63-370.96；P=0.02）。
AI.conclusion: 常规非对比胸部CT上视觉和定量MAC负荷与因晚期房室传导阻滞植入PPM相关。对显著MAC进行结构化评估和报告可能为疑似房室传导疾病患者提供有用的临床标志物。

summary_zh: 本研究旨在确定常规非增强、非心电门控胸部计算机断层扫描（CT）上视觉或定量的二尖瓣环钙化（MAC）负荷是否与因晚期房室（AV）传导阻滞而植入永久起搏器（PPM）相关。MAC 已被认为与经导管主动脉瓣植入术（TAVI）后的传导障碍有关。在非 TAVI 患者中，常规胸部 CT 上可见的 MAC 是否与显著的 AV 传导疾病相关仍不确定。在这项回顾性单中心病例对照研究中，连续 39 例因症状性晚期 AV 传导阻滞而接受 PPM 植入且有非增强胸部 CT 的患者，与 39 例年龄和性别匹配、无 AV 传导阻滞或既往 PPM 的对照者进行比较。MAC 通过瓣环周径受累情况进行视觉分级，并使用基于 Agatston 的评分进行定量。视觉 MAC 在 PPM（+）组中比 PPM（-）组更常见（39 例中 22 例 [56%] 对 39 例中 12 例 [31%]；P = 0.039）。PPM 植入的患病率随视觉 MAC 类别增加而增加，从无 MAC 的 39% 和 MAC 累及瓣环周径 < 1/3 的 48%，到 MAC 累及 1/3 至 1/2 的 80% 和 MAC 累及 > 1/2 瓣环周径的 100%（P = 0.007）。定量 MAC 类别也显示出差异（MAC 评分为 0、1 至 400 和 > 400 时，PPM 植入率分别为 44%、33% 和 78%；P = 0.022）。在多变量分析中，MAC 评分 > 400 仍与 PPM 植入独立相关（比值比：24.6；95% 置信区间：1.63 至 370.96；P = 0.02）。常规非增强胸部 CT 上的视觉和定量 MAC 负荷与因晚期 AV 传导阻滞而植入 PPM 相关。对显著 MAC 进行结构化评估和报告可能为疑似 AV 传导疾病患者提供临床有用的标志物。

title: Adverse Event Profiles of Leadless Pacemaker Systems Reported to the FDA MAUDE Database (2021-2026).
summary:
BACKGROUND: Leadless pacemakers represent a major advance in cardiac rhythm management. The Micra Transcatheter Pacing System (Medtronic) and Aveir Leadless Pacemaker (Abbott) are distinct leadless pacing platforms with different device architectures and implantation mechanics. The FDA Manufacturer and User Facility Device Experience (MAUDE) database provides a real-world source of post-market adverse event reports.

OBJECTIVE: To characterize adverse event profiles of contemporary leadless pacing systems using structured MAUDE data from January 2021 to January 2026, and to assess temporal trends, device problem-patient problem relationships, the timing and reported mechanisms of adverse events and deaths, and generational differences within the Micra platform.

METHODS: Adverse event reports for Micra and Aveir were extracted from the FDA MAUDE database. Records with event dates before January 1, 2021, were excluded. Reports were deduplicated using a structured multi-step process. Analyses were restricted to structured MAUDE fields, including event type, device-problem codes, patient-problem codes, brand name, and dates. Report narratives were additionally analyzed by rule-based text classification with manual validation to clarify ambiguous FDA codes, event timing, and reported mechanisms of death. Each device platform was analyzed independently using descriptive statistics with 95% Wilson confidence intervals.

RESULTS: A total of 14 064 unique reports were included (9973 Micra; 4091 Aveir). Among Micra reports, 7.9% were deaths, 41.1% injuries, and 51.0% malfunctions; high capture threshold (23.7%) was the most frequent device problem, and pericardial effusion (9.0%), cardiac perforation (7.9%), and cardiac tamponade (7.3%) were the leading clinical patient problems. Among Aveir reports, 4.3% were deaths, 32.4% injuries, and 63.3% malfunctions. The leading Aveir device problems were stretching/deformation of the fixation helix (FDA code "Stretched"; 18.3%)-97.7% intra-procedural and 87.2% without clinical consequence-and device dislodgement (18.0%). The code "Embolism/Embolus" (14.0%) denoted device embolization in 97.5% of Aveir reports and was more frequent for the atrial than the ventricular device (20.6% vs. 13.2%, p < 0.001), without decline over time. No clinical signs or symptoms were reported in 64.2% of Micra and 58.5% of Aveir reports. Events were intra-procedural in 45.3% of Micra and 66.4% of Aveir reports, and perforation/effusion/tamponade was the leading reported mechanism of death (51.4% and 67.2%, respectively). Newer-generation Micra devices showed lower reported death proportions than earlier models.

CONCLUSIONS: Leadless pacemaker systems show distinct reported adverse event patterns in real-world post-market surveillance. Micra was characterized mainly by perforation-related complications, whereas Aveir was characterized by fixation-helix damage, dislodgement with device embolization-particularly of the atrial device-and separation-related events. For operators, these findings underscore the importance of device-specific implantation technique, procedural experience, and ongoing learning curve effects in leadless pacing.

AI.tldr: 基于FDA MAUDE数据库2021-2026年14064份报告，Micra不良事件以穿孔相关并发症为主，Aveir以固定螺旋损伤、脱位及器械栓塞（尤其心房器械）为主。
AI.motivation: 无导线起搏器是心律管理的重要进展，Micra与Aveir平台架构和植入机制不同，但缺乏基于真实世界上市后监测数据的系统不良事件谱比较。
AI.method: 回顾性分析FDA MAUDE数据库2021年1月至2026年1月Micra和Aveir不良事件报告，经多步去重后纳入14064份（Micra 9973份，Aveir 4091份），仅分析结构化字段（事件类型、器械问题码、患者问题码、品牌名、日期），并用规则文本分类加人工验证澄清模糊代码、事件时机和死亡机制，各平台独立描述统计并计算95% Wilson置信区间。
AI.result: Micra报告中死亡占7.9%、损伤41.1%、故障51.0%，最常见器械问题为高捕获阈值（23.7%），主要临床患者问题为心包积液（9.0%）、心脏穿孔（7.9%）和心脏压塞（7.3%）；Aveir报告中死亡4.3%、损伤32.4%、故障63.3%，主要器械问题为固定螺旋拉伸/变形（18.3%，97.7%发生于术中，87.2%无临床后果）和器械脱位（18.0%），栓塞/栓子代码（14.0%）在97.5%报告中指器械栓塞，心房器械高于心室器械（20.6% vs 13.2%，p<0.001）且无随时间下降趋势；64.2% Micra和58.5% Aveir报告无临床症状，事件发生于术中者分别为45.3%和66.4%，穿孔/积液/压塞是主要死亡机制（51.4%和67.2%），新一代Micra报告死亡比例低于早期型号。
AI.conclusion: 无导线起搏器真实世界不良事件谱因平台而异：Micra以穿孔相关并发症为主，Aveir以固定螺旋损伤、脱位伴器械栓塞（尤其心房器械）及分离相关事件为主；提示术者需掌握器械特异性植入技术、积累经验并关注学习曲线效应，但MAUDE数据存在自愿报告和报告偏倚等局限。

summary_zh:
背景：无导线起搏器代表心律管理领域的重大进展。Micra经导管起搏系统（美敦力）和Aveir无导线起搏器（雅培）是两种具有不同器械结构和植入机制的无导线起搏平台。FDA制造商与用户设施器械经验（MAUDE）数据库提供了真实世界的上市后不良事件报告来源。

目的：利用2021年1月至2026年1月的结构化MAUDE数据，描述当代无导线起搏系统的不良事件特征，并评估时间趋势、器械问题-患者问题关系、不良事件和死亡的时间及报告机制，以及Micra平台内的代际差异。

方法：从FDA MAUDE数据库中提取Micra和Aveir的不良事件报告。排除事件日期早于2021年1月1日的记录。采用结构化多步骤流程对报告进行去重。分析仅限于结构化MAUDE字段，包括事件类型、器械问题代码、患者问题代码、品牌名称和日期。此外，通过基于规则的文本分类并辅以人工验证对报告叙述进行分析，以澄清模糊的FDA代码、事件时间和报告的死亡机制。每个器械平台使用描述性统计及95% Wilson置信区间独立分析。

结果：共纳入14 064份唯一报告（9973份Micra；4091份Aveir）。在Micra报告中，7.9%为死亡，41.1%为伤害，51.0%为故障；高捕获阈值（23.7%）是最常见的器械问题，心包积液（9.0%）、心脏穿孔（7.9%）和心脏压塞（7.3%）是主要的临床患者问题。在Aveir报告中，4.3%为死亡，32.4%为伤害，63.3%为故障。Aveir主要的器械问题为固定螺旋的拉伸/变形（FDA代码“Stretched”；18.3%）——97.7%发生于术中，87.2%无临床后果——以及器械脱位（18.0%）。代码“Embolism/Embolus”（14.0%）在97.5%的Aveir报告中表示器械栓塞，且心房器械比心室器械更常见（20.6% vs. 13.2%，p < 0.001），随时间无下降。64.2%的Micra报告和58.5%的Aveir报告未报告临床体征或症状。事件发生于术中的比例在Micra报告中为45.3%，在Aveir报告中为66.4%，穿孔/积液/压塞是报告的主要死亡机制（分别为51.4%和67.2%）。新一代Micra器械报告的死亡比例低于早期型号。

结论：无导线起搏系统在真实世界上市后监测中显示出不同的报告不良事件模式。Micra主要以穿孔相关并发症为特征，而Aveir则以固定螺旋损伤、脱位伴器械栓塞——尤其是心房器械——以及分离相关事件为特征。对于操作者而言，这些发现强调了器械特异性植入技术、手术经验以及无导线起搏中持续学习曲线效应的重要性。

title: Predictors of Success in Fractured Electrode Extraction: The Impact of Fracture Location and Access Strategies.
summary:
INTRODUCTION: Fractured or sheared cardiac implantable electronic device leads presents a unique clinical challenge in transvenous lead extraction. These cases are associated with clinical failure rates of up to 40% and a greater likelihood of retained fragments. The aim of this study was to characterize fractured lead extractions performed at a referral center and identify predictors of complete removal and clinical success.

METHODS: We conducted a retrospective single center study including all consecutive patients who underwent TLE for electrodes fractured before or during extraction between October 2011 and December 2025. Clinical, echocardiographic, and procedural data were collected.

RESULTS: A total of 46 procedures were analyzed. Mean age was 62.7 years and median lead dwell time was 9.0 years. The most frequent fracture site was the electrode body (67.4%). A rotational mechanical sheath was used in 84.8% of cases (39/46), and femoral snaring was used in 60.8%. Complete extraction occurred in 32.6% whereas clinical success was achieved in 80.4% of patients. Retained fragments > 4 cm were observed in 28.3%. In multivariate analysis, the use of a 13Fr sheath was independently associated with lower odds of clinical success (p = 0.011). Fracture location was the only consistent independent predictor of complete extraction (p = 0.031). Femoral access showed a favorable trend but did not reach statistical significance after adjustment.

CONCLUSIONS: In fractured lead extraction, fracture location is the strongest predictor of complete removal, surpassing clinical and procedural variables. These findings highlight the importance of preoperative planning and suggest that femoral access may play a key role in selected complex cases.

AI.method: 单中心回顾性研究，纳入2011年10月至2025年12月因电极断裂（拔除前或术中）接受经静脉拔除的连续患者46例，收集临床、超声和手术数据，分析完全拔除和临床成功的预测因素。
AI.result: 平均年龄62.7岁，电极中位留置时间9.0年，断裂部位最常见于电极体（67.4%）。使用旋转机械鞘84.8%，股静脉圈套60.8%。完全拔除率32.6%，临床成功率80.4%，残留碎片>4 cm占28.3%。多因素分析显示13Fr鞘管使用与临床成功几率降低独立相关（p=0.011），断裂位置是完全拔除的唯一独立预测因素（p=0.031），股静脉入路调整后未达统计学显著性。
AI.conclusion: 在断裂电极拔除中，断裂位置是比临床和手术变量更强的完全拔除预测因素，提示术前规划的重要性，股静脉入路可能在部分复杂病例中起关键作用；但本研究为单中心回顾性设计，样本量有限，结论需进一步验证。

引言：断裂或剪切的心脏植入式电子器械导线在经静脉导线拔除中构成了独特的临床挑战。这些病例的临床失败率高达40%，且残留碎片的可能性更大。本研究旨在描述转诊中心实施的断裂导线拔除术的特征，并确定完全拔除和临床成功的预测因素。

方法：我们进行了一项回顾性单中心研究，纳入2011年10月至2025年12月期间因拔除前或拔除过程中电极断裂而接受TLE的所有连续患者。收集了临床、超声心动图和手术数据。

结论：在断裂导线拔除中，断裂位置是完全拔除的最强预测因素，超过了临床和手术变量。这些发现强调了术前规划的重要性，并提示股静脉入路可能在选定的复杂病例中发挥关键作用。

title: The role of genetic testing in heart transplant candidates.
summary:
PURPOSE OF REVIEW: Inherited cardiomyopathies are increasingly recognized among patients with advanced heart failure, yet genetic testing remains substantially underutilized. This review examines the evolving clinical utility of genetic testing across advanced heart failure and transplantation and highlights opportunities to integrate genetics into routine advanced heart failure care.

RECENT FINDINGS: Pathogenic or likely pathogenic cardiomyopathy variants are identified in approximately one-third of heart transplant recipients and in up to 44% of explanted hearts from patients with idiopathic cardiomyopathy. Recent studies have linked genotype to heart failure progression, ventricular arrhythmias, and outcomes after advanced therapies, including a higher risk of right ventricular failure following left ventricular assist device implantation. Genetic diagnoses can also uncover multisystem disease relevant to transplant evaluation and posttransplant management. At the same time, the emergence of gene replacement, gene editing, and RNA-based therapies is creating new therapeutic implications for establishing a molecular diagnosis before end-stage disease.

SUMMARY: Genetic testing is becoming an increasingly actionable component of advanced heart failure care. Integrating genetics into advanced heart failure programs may improve recognition of inherited disease, individualize management, and better position patients and their families for emerging precision therapies.

AI.method: 综述性文章，系统回顾遗传检测在晚期心衰和心脏移植中的最新证据。纳入近期关于移植受者及离体心脏遗传变异检出率、基因型与心衰进展、室性心律失常、晚期治疗预后（包括左心室辅助装置植入后右心衰风险）以及多系统疾病识别的研究，并讨论基因替代、基因编辑和RNA疗法等新兴治疗对分子诊断时机的影响。

title: Family screening and genetic testing in transthyretin cardiac amyloidosis : Changing (not only) variant transthyretin cardiac amyloidosis.
summary: With increasing awareness of transthyretin amyloid cardiomyopathy (ATTR-CM) as a cause of heart failure and the availability of disease-modifying therapies, the importance of early diagnosis has grown. Consequently, greater emphasis has been placed on genetic testing and family screening to identify individuals with variant transthyretin amyloidosis (ATTRv) who are at risk of developing ATTRv cardiomyopathy (ATTRv-CM). To identify individuals with a genetic predisposition to the disease, all individuals with ATTR-CM should undergo genetic testing with subsequent cascade genetic testing in relatives when a genetic variant is identified. In asymptomatic pathogenic/likely pathogenic (P/LP) transthyretin (TTR) variant carriers, structured follow-up is recommended to enable early diagnosis, allowing timely initiation of treatment. Additionally, systematic family screening protocols may also help identify and detect ATTR-CM in general, including wild-type ATTR-CM.In conclusion, this narrative review provides clinicians with an overview of how to manage patients with ATTRv-CM and their families. Indeed, comprehensive genetic and cascade screening strategies are essential for early identification and optimal management of ATTR-CM. Future perspectives include refinement of risk stratification, optimization of diagnostic and screening pathways, improved timing of treatment initiation, and addressing health inequalities to ensure equitable access to care.

AI.tldr: 所有ATTR-CM患者均应接受基因检测，并对检出致病变异者的亲属进行级联筛查，以早期识别ATTRv-CM并启动治疗。
AI.motivation: 随着对转甲状腺素蛋白淀粉样心肌病（ATTR-CM）作为心衰病因的认识提高及疾病修饰疗法的出现，早期诊断愈发重要。然而，目前对基因检测和家系筛查在识别变异型ATTR（ATTRv）携带者及早期ATTRv-CM中的系统应用仍缺乏统一策略，既往证据多聚焦于诊断后的治疗，对筛查路径关注不足。
AI.method: 本文为叙述性综述，旨在为临床医生提供ATTRv-CM患者及其家系的管理概述。文章综合现有证据，提出所有ATTR-CM患者均应进行基因检测，若发现致病变异，则对其亲属进行级联基因检测；对无症状的致病/可能致病（P/LP）TTR变异携带者，推荐结构化随访以早期诊断。综述未报告具体样本量、终点定义或统计方法。
AI.result: 摘要未报告原始研究数据、效应量、95%置信区间或P值。综述指出，系统的家系筛查方案可能有助于识别和检测ATTR-CM，包括野生型ATTR-CM；对无症状P/LP TTR变异携带者进行结构化随访可实现早期诊断并及时启动治疗。
AI.conclusion: 全面的基因检测和级联筛查策略对于ATTR-CM的早期识别和优化管理至关重要。未来方向包括细化风险分层、优化诊断和筛查路径、改进治疗启动时机以及解决健康不平等以确保公平获得医疗。本文为叙述性综述，未提供原始数据，结论基于现有证据整合，需前瞻性研究验证筛查策略的临床获益。

summary_zh: 随着对转甲状腺素蛋白淀粉样心肌病（ATTR-CM）作为心力衰竭病因的认识不断提高以及疾病修饰疗法的可用性，早期诊断的重要性日益增加。因此，人们更加重视基因检测和家族筛查，以识别有发生ATTRv心肌病（ATTRv-CM）风险的变异型转甲状腺素蛋白淀粉样变性（ATTRv）个体。为了识别具有疾病遗传易感性的个体，所有ATTR-CM个体都应接受基因检测，并在发现基因变异时对亲属进行后续的级联基因检测。对于无症状的致病性/可能致病性（P/LP）转甲状腺素蛋白（TTR）变异携带者，建议进行结构化随访以实现早期诊断，从而及时启动治疗。此外，系统性的家族筛查方案也可能有助于在总体上识别和检测ATTR-CM，包括野生型ATTR-CM。总之，本叙述性综述为临床医生提供了如何管理ATTRv-CM患者及其家庭的概述。事实上，全面的遗传和级联筛查策略对于ATTR-CM的早期识别和优化管理至关重要。未来展望包括完善风险分层、优化诊断和筛查路径、改进治疗启动时机以及解决健康不平等问题以确保公平获得医疗照护。

title: Expanded Characterization of Ventricular Electrogram in Selective Left Bundle Branch Pacing: A Cohort Study of Patients With/Without LBB Potential.
summary:
AIMS: The electrophysiological transition from non-selective to selective capture with electrogram (EGM)-splitting during threshold testing is the gold standard for verifying left-bundle-branch (LBB) capture in LBB-area pacing. Our preliminary study identified distinct ventricular EGM morphologies in patients with recordable LBB potentials. The present study extends these observations to patients with and without LBB potentials and characterizes the electrophysiological features and potential mechanistic correlates of these EGM phenotypes during selective LBB (S-LBB) pacing.

METHODS: Patients with confirmed S-LBB pacing were categorized into three groups based on the comparison between intrinsic and paced ventricular EGM morphologies: concordant (CE), similar (SE), and discordant (DE). Baseline characteristics, pacing indications, pacing parameters, and V6 R-wave peak times (RWPTs) were analyzed.

RESULTS: S-LBB pacing was achieved in 387 patients (86.8%). After excluding patients with LBBB, an LBB potential was recorded in 276/341 patients (80.9%). Among patients with an LBB potential, V-V6(P) RWPT and V-V6(S) RWPT were strongly correlated in the CE (r = 0.889) and SE groups (r = 0.825), whereas V-V6(S) RWPT was significantly shorter in the DE group. Among patients without an LBB potential, the DE group also showed a shorter V-V6(S) RWPT. There was a strong correlation between V-V6(P) RWPT and V-V6(S) RWPT in the CE group (r = 0.815), while the DE group exhibited a poor correlation (r = 0.351).

CONCLUSIONS: Continuous recording using a 200 Hz high-pass filter effectively confirms S-LBB pacing by revealing discrete EGM signals. Concordant or similar intrinsic and paced EGMs may suggest shared conduction pathways, whereas discordant EGMs might reflect distinct conduction routes.

AI.tldr: 在387例成功行选择性左束支起搏的患者中，根据自身与起搏心室电图形态分为一致、相似和不一致三组，一致/相似组V6导联R波峰值时间与起搏参数强相关，提示共享传导通路，而不一致组相关性差，可能反映不同传导路径。
AI.motivation: 左束支区域起搏中，通过阈值测试时电图分裂从非选择性夺获过渡到选择性夺获是验证左束支夺获的金标准。前期研究在可记录到左束支电位的患者中发现了不同的心室电图形态，但尚未在有无左束支电位的患者中系统描述这些电图表型的电生理特征及潜在机制。
AI.method: 本研究为队列研究，纳入确认行选择性左束支起搏的患者，根据自身与起搏心室电图形态比较分为一致组、相似组和不一致组。分析基线特征、起搏指征、起搏参数及V6导联R波峰值时间。采用相关分析评估自身与起搏V6导联R波峰值时间的相关性。
AI.result: 387例（86.8%）患者成功实现选择性左束支起搏。排除左束支传导阻滞患者后，276/341例（80.9%）记录到左束支电位。在有左束支电位的患者中，一致组和相似组的自身与起搏V6导联R波峰值时间强相关（r=0.889和r=0.825），而不一致组的起搏V6导联R波峰值时间显著缩短。在无左束支电位的患者中，不一致组也表现出起搏V6导联R波峰值时间缩短。一致组自身与起搏V6导联R波峰值时间强相关（r=0.815），而不一致组相关性差（r=0.351）。
AI.conclusion: 使用200 Hz高通滤波器连续记录可通过显示离散电图信号有效确认选择性左束支起搏。自身与起搏心室电图一致或相似可能提示共享传导通路，而不一致电图可能反映不同的传导路径。这些发现有助于理解选择性左束支起搏的电生理机制，但需进一步研究验证其临床意义。

summary_zh:
目的：在阈值测试期间，从非选择性夺获到选择性夺获并伴有电图（EGM）分裂的电生理转变，是验证左束支区域起搏中左束支（LBB）夺获的金标准。我们的初步研究在可记录到LBB电位的患者中识别出不同的心室EGM形态。本研究将这些观察扩展到有或无LBB电位的患者，并表征选择性LBB（S-LBB）起搏期间这些EGM表型的电生理特征和可能的机制相关性。

方法：确诊为S-LBB起搏的患者根据自身与起搏心室EGM形态的比较分为三组：一致（CE）、相似（SE）和不一致（DE）。分析基线特征、起搏适应症、起搏参数和V6 R波峰值时间（RWPT）。

结果：387例患者（86.8%）实现了S-LBB起搏。排除LBBB患者后，276/341例患者（80.9%）记录到LBB电位。在有LBB电位的患者中，CE组（r = 0.889）和SE组（r = 0.825）的V-V6(P) RWPT与V-V6(S) RWPT强相关，而DE组的V-V6(S) RWPT显著较短。在无LBB电位的患者中，DE组也显示较短的V-V6(S) RWPT。CE组中V-V6(P) RWPT与V-V6(S) RWPT之间存在强相关（r = 0.815），而DE组相关性较差（r = 0.351）。

结论：使用200 Hz高通滤波器连续记录通过揭示离散EGM信号有效确认S-LBB起搏。自身与起搏EGM一致或相似可能提示共享传导通路，而不一致的EGM可能反映不同的传导路径。
